# CliSAT attribution notice

This directory contains a compiled Linux x86-64 binary of CliSAT used by Part D.2 of the GCO-HPIF pipeline.

Original project: <https://github.com/psanse/CliSAT>

CliSAT is described in:

> Pablo San Segundo, Fabio Furini, David Álvarez, and Panos M. Pardalos.  
> "CliSAT: A SAT-based exact algorithm for hard maximum clique problems."  
> *European Journal of Operational Research*, 307(3), 1008-1025, 2023.

The CliSAT software is released under the Unlicense / public-domain dedication. See `LICENSE` in this directory.
